entries.title: Platform Overview
entries.content: Dutchkem Trading AI is a production-grade web and mobile trading platform for forex and commodities. Uses Three-Power Model Architecture with @devhive (orchestration), @gstack (23 specialized agents), and @minimax (code generation). Targets 0.14% daily equity growth (40% annualized / 365) with 15% max drawdown.

entries.title: Daily Performance Targets
entries.content: Daily Growth: 0.14% per day (40% annualized / 365). Monthly Growth: ~4.2% per month. Annual Growth: ~50%+ per year (compounded daily). Max Daily Loss: 2%. Daily Target Lock: Trading stops at 0.4% daily gain. Max Daily Trades: 10. Position Size: 1% per trade.

entries.title: Multi-Timeframe Support
entries.content: Supports 6 timeframes: M5 (scalping, 5-10 trades/day, 1-2% daily), M15 (momentum, 3-5 trades/day, 0.8-1.5% daily), M30 (swing, 2-3 trades/day, 0.5-1% daily), H1 (trend, 1-2 trades/day, 0.3-0.6% daily), H2 (position, 0-1 trades/day, 0.2-0.4% daily), H4 (strategic, 0-1 trades/day, 0.1-0.3% daily).

entries.title: Tech Stack
entries.content: Backend: Django 4.2 + DRF, PostgreSQL 16 + TimescaleDB, Redis 7, InfluxDB 2.7, RabbitMQ, Django Channels. Frontend: React 18, React Native 0.73+. MCP: SYNX-MT5-MCP (68+ tools), AkTools Pro (65+ tools), OpenAlgo (100+ indicators), CrossTrade, OpenTrading.

entries.title: Risk Management Rules
entries.content: Max Daily Loss: 2% of equity. Max Drawdown: 15% of total equity. Max Position Size: 1% per trade. Max Open Positions: 5 per instrument. Max Daily Trades: 10. Min Risk-Reward: 1:2. Daily Target Lock: Trading stops at 0.4% daily gain.

entries.title: Payment Methods
entries.content: Deposits: Bank Transfer (1-3 days, $100 min), Card (instant, $50 min), Crypto (10-60 min, $50 min), PayPal/Skrill/Neteller (instant, $50 min), Mobile Money (instant, $10 min). Withdrawals: Same methods with varying fees.
